title: Null Run tower vertical-layout design tables
status: proposal; no engine sectors, collision or navigation have been changed

conversion.note: 1 m = 64 Doom units as requested; native map tiles are 128 units.

global_rules.real_height: Every level has a distinct walkable floor z; towers rise 15 m, 15 m and 18 m.
global_rules.stairs: 8 risers of 0.1875 m (12 Doom units) + 1.8 m landing per flight; 3.0 m storey.
global_rules.lifts: Static cage/car/landing proposals only; no moving lift is implemented or claimed.
global_rules.fall_recovery: Every open edge has a returnable catch surface and a stair connection.
global_rules.no_cheap_hits: No enemy is placed in the first 6 native tiles of a spawn; no attack through opaque geometry.
global_rules.no_mandatory_jumps: Required routes use stairs/landings only. Optional gaps are guarded and have alternatives.
global_rules.mesh_vs_native: Native step/headroom limits are separate from mesh collision proxies; Codex owns conversion.

tower_proof.circulation: two 1.5 m stair flights plus a 1.5 m landing per storey; the chain lift is a second independent route from F0 to F5
tower_proof.not_faked_by: no single tall ceiling, no camera tilt, no non-walkable decorative gantry; every named level has a walkable floor

landmark.name: The Ninth Bell
landmark.description: The cracked ninth bell hangs in the central casting shaft between F3 and F5. Its crown gimbal is the F4 sightline; the cage is the F3 landmark. The bell is visible from the F0 pit through an open chain well, but cannot be reached by jumping.

routes.lower: F0 sand pit -> west casting aisle -> furnace chest cover -> two-flight stair to F1. The F0 ceiling is open to the chain well above the sand bed; the player sees the bell but the route is the stair.
routes.middle: F1 maintenance gantry -> chain-lift landing -> F2 furnace throat -> stair to F3. The F2 gantry crosses the flue on a 2.0 m bridge with guardrails; the lift cage passes beside it, not through it.
routes.upper: F3 lift landing -> F4 crown gimbal gallery -> F5 crown gallery. The last storey is a switchback stair around the bell crown; the summit is a real 15.0 m floor overlooking the whole shaft.

stair_alternative.description: Every storey has a complete two-flight stair: 8 risers at 0.1875 m (12 Doom units), a 1.8 m landing, then 8 more risers. The stair is never blocked by the lift.

lift_alternative.description: The chain lift is an explicit second route: a static cage mesh proposal plus a chain-and-counterweight landmark. In the first pass it is a fixed platform at each landing, not a moving lift; the stair is the guaranteed route.
lift_alternative.status: static landmark proposal; moving lift behaviour is unimplemented

fall_recovery.main_void: The central casting shaft is open from F1 to F4. A dropped object or player lands on the F0 sand bed, which is a 0.35 m soft mound, not a kill plane.
catch_surfaces: F0 sand bed under the shaft
fall_recovery.return: From the F0 sand bed, the west aisle leads back to the F0 stair in under 20 m. No one-way drop is on the required route.
fall_recovery.damage_note: Fall damage is engine-owned; this table only guarantees a return floor.

safe_spawn.description: A sealed sand-pit entry behind the furnace chest, with two exits and the bell visible overhead as a bearing.
safe_spawn.enemy_clearance: at least 6 native 128-unit tiles (12 m at 64 u/m) from the first encounter
safe_spawn.cover: furnace chest and two casting flasks; no spawn inside the chain well

return_path.description: Every level carries the same bearings: wall 07 bell/landmark is on the shaft side, wall 08 lift/cage is on the stair side. From any gallery the stair head is visible within one room length.
return_path.wayfinding: landmark panels 07/08 plus the lit furnace ceiling flat 04

rules: no perch directly above a spawn or a required stair head
every perch has a stair or ramp return, never a jump-only exit
at least two 1.6 m-wide routes around each arena

room_over_room.description: F1 maintenance gantries bridge over the F0 sand pit and furnace aisle.
F2 furnace throat sits above the F1 gantry; its flue passes through the floor beside the stair.
The bell shaft is a true three-storey void; F4 and F5 walkable galleries overhang the F3 landing.

first_pass_constraints.notes: Required routes are stairs and a static lift landing. Optional chain galleries may have 1.6 m gaps, but each has a guardrail and a stair alternative. No enemy is placed in the first 6 tiles of the spawn.

native_constraints.player_clearance_note: minimum headroom used by the reviewed threshold checks; nominal player body height remains engine-owned
native_constraints.notes: Native step and headroom figures come from the reviewed threshold checks; engine collision remains Codex-owned.

mesh_constraints.landing_component: shared_stair_landing: deck at 1.5 m, 1.8 m square
required_collision: stair steps as walkable step surfaces
bell/cage as overhead and shell proxies
mesh_constraints.notes: Mesh collision is a proposal; Codex must convert to native sectors or source-port collision.

tower_proof.circulation: a spiral root stair from F0 to F5 plus a counterweight gantry from F1 to F4; the two routes are independent after F1
tower_proof.not_faked_by: the glasshouse atrium is a real multi-storey void; every named level has a walkable bed, walk or gallery

landmark.name: The Root Cage
landmark.description: The empty root cage hangs through the atrium from the F4 canopy to the F3 landing, suspended over a black void. The descending canopy above it is the F4-F5 ceiling; the growth lamps are the safe bearings.

routes.lower: F0 peat floor -> dry gravel aisle -> growth chamber cover -> root stair to F1. The F0 ceiling is the open nursery floor above; beds are visible through root gaps, but the route is the stair.
routes.middle: F1 nursery beds -> watering gantry arch -> F2 gantry walk -> root stair to F3. The F2 gantry crosses over the beds on a 2.0 m bridge with rails.
routes.upper: F3 root cage landing -> F4 canopy walk -> F5 lantern roof. The last flight is a switchback through hanging roots; the summit is a real 15.0 m glasshouse lantern floor.

stair_alternative.description: A continuous root-wrapped spiral stair uses the same 8-riser flights and 1.8 m landings; the root texture is cosmetic over the shared stair geometry.

lift_alternative.description: A counterweighted watering gantry platform links F1, F2 and F4. It is a slow open platform, not a jump; the stair remains the guaranteed route. Delivered as a static landing proposal; moving platform behaviour is unimplemented.
lift_alternative.status: static landmark proposal; moving platform behaviour is unimplemented

fall_recovery.main_void: The glasshouse atrium is open from F1 to F4. Soft peat beds at F0 and planter shelves at F1/F2 catch a fall.
fall_recovery.return: F0 peat beds connect to the root stair within 18 m; no one-way drop is required to progress.
fall_recovery.damage_note: Fall damage is engine-owned; every fall lands on a returnable floor.

safe_spawn.description: A dry gravel entry between two peat beds, under the first planter shelf, with the root stair visible to the left and a growth chamber as cover.
safe_spawn.enemy_clearance: at least 6 native tiles (12 m at 64 u/m) from the first encounter
safe_spawn.cover: two growth chambers and a root cage planter; no spawn under the cage

return_path.description: The pale growth lamps and the descending root curtain are visible from every level. Wall 07 (root cage) faces the atrium; wall 08 (canopy) faces the stair. The stair head is always within one room.
return_path.wayfinding: landmark panels 07/08 and the pale glow of flat 04

rules: no perch directly over the root cage void or a spawn
every perch has a planter-shelf or stair return
growth chambers provide cover but never block the only route

room_over_room.description: F1 nursery beds sit over the F0 peat floor; roots and glass panels show the room above.
The F2 watering gantry crosses over the F1 beds; roses and drip lines hang into the room below.
The root cage void is a three-storey open volume; the F4 canopy walk and F5 lantern roof overhang it.

first_pass_constraints.notes: Required routes are the root stair and the static gantry landing. Planter shelves are optional, guarded and have stair returns. Nothing attacks through the opaque glass of a growth chamber.

native_constraints.player_clearance_note: minimum headroom used by the reviewed threshold checks; nominal player body height remains engine-owned
native_constraints.notes: Native step and headroom figures come from the reviewed threshold checks; engine collision remains Codex-owned.

mesh_constraints.landing_component: shared_stair_landing: deck at 1.5 m, 1.8 m square
required_collision: planter and cage as solid proxies
mesh_constraints.notes: Mesh collision is a proposal; Codex must convert to native sectors or source-port collision.

tower_proof.circulation: a fire stair from B1 to F6 plus a service lift from B1 to F6; both are independent. Guest balconies are stacked at real 3.0 m floor pitches around the atrium void.
tower_proof.not_faked_by: no tall painted atrium; the service well is an open shaft with walkable balconies at each level and real room-over-room floors

landmark.name: The 33rd Floor Lift
landmark.description: The brass service lift opens on an amber gap at F2 and F3, with an impossible indicator mark. The F3 landing faces the atrium cutaway; the F6 observation deck looks down the whole 18 m well.

routes.lower: B1 laundry -> service corridor -> dumbwaiter winch cover -> fire stair to F1. The laundry net and linen chute shelves are visible below the open service well but the route is the stair.
routes.middle: F1 linen service -> F2 service well -> service lift landing -> F3 first guest balcony. The F2 landing is a real floor around the open well, with guardrails on every unrailed edge.
routes.upper: F3 -> F4 -> F5 guest balconies are staggered around the atrium; the fire stair switchbacks at the service core and reaches F6. The observation deck is a real 18.0 m floor with a guarded view down the well.

stair_alternative.description: A fire stair with the same two-flight rhythm runs the full height. Its landings are offset around the service core, so it reads as a different spatial experience from the straight foundry stair.

lift_alternative.description: The service lift is an explicit second route from B1 to F6. The delivered mesh is a static car/shaft proposal; the moving car and call logic are unimplemented, so the fire stair is guaranteed.
lift_alternative.status: static landmark proposal; moving lift behaviour is unimplemented

fall_recovery.main_void: The service atrium is open from F1 to F6. Guest balconies are set back 2.0 m from the void edge and have 1.1 m guardrails.
catch_surfaces: B1 laundry net at 0.5 m depth
F2 service-well roof over the dumbwaiter
fall_recovery.return: The B1 laundry net connects to the fire stair within 22 m; no required route uses an unguarded drop.
fall_recovery.damage_note: Fall damage is engine-owned; every fall lands on a returnable surface.

safe_spawn.description: A laundry entry behind a linen cart, with the fire stair visible through a service door and the lift indicator as a second bearing.
safe_spawn.enemy_clearance: at least 6 native tiles (12 m at 64 u/m) from the first encounter
safe_spawn.cover: linen carts and the dumbwaiter winch; no spawn inside the lift car

return_path.description: Amber floor ticks and the repeated room-number paddle mark the fire stair on every balcony. Wall 07 (lift) faces the service core; wall 08 (atrium) faces the void. The stair is never more than one balcony bay away.
return_path.wayfinding: landmark panels 07/08 and the amber lit ceiling flat 04

rules: no perch over the open atrium or directly above a spawn
every balcony perch has a stair or lift landing return
guardrails on every unrailed edge; no jump-only shortcut

room_over_room.description: F1 linen service rooms sit directly over B1 laundry and the chute shelves.
F2 service-well roof covers the F1 linen store while the atrium opens beside it.
Staggered guest balconies overhang one another around the void, each a real 3.0 m floor pitch; F6 observation deck caps the well.

first_pass_constraints.notes: Required routes are the fire stair and the static lift landings. Balcony gaps are optional and guarded. No enemy fires through the opaque rain windows; all attack lanes are visible before entry.

native_constraints.player_clearance_note: minimum headroom used by the reviewed threshold checks; nominal player body height remains engine-owned
native_constraints.notes: Native step and headroom figures come from the reviewed threshold checks; engine collision remains Codex-owned.

required_collision: balcony floor at 0.16 m above level
lift car shell and dumbwaiter as solid proxies
